method: Each day lists one primary event and, where a second event exists with a confirmed fee and guarantee that does not overlap the primary's registration window, one conditional fallback. A confirmed single-entry event is always preferred as the primary; the fallback may be a re-entry, multi-flight or unverified format and is labelled with its entry status. Ranking happens only after the total fee and the guarantee are confirmed from an official structure sheet. Restart rows (Day 2 and final-table continuations) are never offered as primary events because they take no new entry.
overlap_rule: The overlap test uses the printed late-registration cutoff, the last moment a second entry can be taken. No official source publishes a projected finish time, so a single-day event that runs past its cutoff could still overlap a later start; the late-registration cutoff is the published and practical proxy.
walking_note: Venetian to Wynn is the only inter-venue walk that matters for these days and is computed at 13 minutes; both venues are also used on the same calendar days during the WPT Championship. See the walking-time table for the full matrix.
